logging_target.description: Where to send logs: 'syslog' for system logging, 'file' to write to a dedicated log file

log_file_path.description: Path to the log file when logging_target is 'file'

log_level.description: Minimum level of messages to log (debug, info, notice, warning, error, crit, alert, emerg)

log_timestamp_format.description: Format of timestamps in logs: 'none', 'date', 'full', or 'iso8601'

event_handler.description:
List of event handlers to register. Each handler runs an external command on cluster events.
Note: 'user' and 'group' directives are not supported by corosync_notifyd and have been removed per documentation.

items.description: Configuration for a single event handler.

properties.description: Properties for a single event handler configuration.
